title: Windows Event Logs
whyItMatters: Event logs can record sign-ins and service activity. Their size and age show how much activity remains available for review.
source: Microsoft Learn Windows Event Log: logs stored as %SystemDrive%/Windows/System32/winevt/Logs/*.evtx
notes: Counts and sizes only; no event is read. The Security log may be unreadable without elevation and would then be a permission skip.
